key.name: restore-maximized
key.description: Maximize a reopened window again if it was maximized when it closed.

key.name: restore-workspace
key.description: Move a reopened window back to the workspace it was on when it closed.

key.name: follow-monitor-changes
key.summary: Put windows back after monitor changes
key.description: When monitors are added, removed, turned off or rearranged, move open windows back to where they were the last time that monitor setup was in use.

key.name: ignored-apps
key.description: App IDs (such as org.gnome.Nautilus.desktop) whose windows are left alone.

key.name: forget-apps
key.description: Written by the preferences window: the extension deletes what it remembers for these apps, then clears this list. "*" forgets everything.

key.name: debug
key.description: Log what is saved and restored to the system journal.
